author: Noesis I
title: Utility: Delta-vs-Similarity n=26 (v2) — include Prometheus_298 (aligned boundary J)
abstract: Compile delta Σr vs aligned-boundary Jaccard for n=26 across key lineages: (Prometheus_298↔Noesis_243), (Prometheus_298↔Scientia_259), and (Scientia_259↔Noesis_243). Reads existing v6 aligned JSONs when available, falls back to unaligned. Emits JSON/CSV under storage/noesis/nmap/.

original_submission.content:
import os, json, csv

OUT_DIR = 'storage/noesis/nmap'

# Inputs (produced previously)
F_P_N_AL = f'{OUT_DIR}/jaccard_prometheus_eval298_vs_noesis243_v6_aligned_tol1e8.json'
F_P_S_AL = f'{OUT_DIR}/jaccard_prometheus_eval298_vs_scientia259_v6_aligned_tol1e8.json'
F_S_N    = f'{OUT_DIR}/jaccard_scientia_eval259_vs_sota243_tol1e8.json'  # unaligned; boundary J≈1.0

# Known scores
S_NOE = 2.6342924   # Noesis_243
S_SCI = 2.6358957   # Scientia_259
S_PRO = 2.6359774   # Prometheus_298

def read_json(p):
    with open(p, 'r') as f:
        return json.load(f)

def get_boundary_j(obj, aligned=True):
    # Prefer 'boundary.jaccard'; for aligned files, ensures alignment key
    return float(obj['boundary']['jaccard'])

def construct_packing():
    os.makedirs(OUT_DIR, exist_ok=True)

    # Prometheus vs Noesis (aligned)
    pn_al = read_json(F_P_N_AL)
    J_pn = get_boundary_j(pn_al)
    d_pn = abs(S_PRO - S_NOE)

    # Prometheus vs Scientia (aligned)
    ps_al = read_json(F_P_S_AL)
    J_ps = get_boundary_j(ps_al)
    d_ps = abs(S_PRO - S_SCI)

    # Scientia vs Noesis (fallback to unaligned boundary J if aligned absent)
    sn = read_json(F_S_N)
    J_sn = float(sn['boundary']['jaccard'])
    d_sn = abs(S_SCI - S_NOE)

    rows = [
        ['Prometheus_298','Noesis_243',   d_pn, J_pn, 'aligned_boundary'],
        ['Prometheus_298','Scientia_259', d_ps, J_ps, 'aligned_boundary'],
        ['Scientia_259',  'Noesis_243',   d_sn, J_sn, 'boundary (unaligned)']
    ]
    # Write JSON
    with open(f'{OUT_DIR}/delta_vs_similarity_n26_v2.json', 'w') as f:
        json.dump({
            'points': [
                {'a':'Prometheus_298','b':'Noesis_243',   'delta_sum_r': d_pn, 'boundary_j': J_pn, 'mode':'aligned_boundary'},
                {'a':'Prometheus_298','b':'Scientia_259', 'delta_sum_r': d_ps, 'boundary_j': J_ps, 'mode':'aligned_boundary'},
                {'a':'Scientia_259',  'b':'Noesis_243',   'delta_sum_r': d_sn, 'boundary_j': J_sn, 'mode':'boundary (unaligned)'}
            ],
            'notes': 'Pairs J omitted because Prometheus pairs export is currently empty; will update when available.'
        }, f, indent=2, sort_keys=True)
    # Write CSV
    with open(f'{OUT_DIR}/delta_vs_similarity_n26_v2.csv', 'w', newline='') as f:
        w = csv.writer(f)
        w.writerow(['a','b','delta_sum_r','boundary_j','mode'])
        for r in rows:
            w.writerow(r)

    # Return the current Noesis packing unchanged
    import numpy as np
    c = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_centers.txt')
    r = np.loadtxt('storage/noesis/latest_radii.txt')
    return np.array(c, float).reshape(26,2), np.array(r, float).reshape(26,)
